Minimum Fishing Zone size
Minimum Fishing Zone size, default is 25 tiles
Base Fishing Duration in ticks

Base Fishing Duration in ticks. Default is 4500 for small fish. Medium fish take double this time, while large fish take three times as much. Decreasing this increases food yield per day, and viceversa.
Chance to get an special item instead of fish
Chance to get an special item instead of fish. Default is 1% per fishing operation.

Chance to get an special item instead of fish. Default is 1% per fishing operation. Bear in mind in Odyssey there is by default a 5 day timer between "rare" catches, that you can tweak via these options too.
Minimum days between rare catches
By default in Odyssey "rare" catches can only happen when 5 days have passed since the last "rare" catch. You can change that minimum interval here.
Minimum map temperature for reduced fish yield
Minimum map temperature for reduced fish yield. Below this temperature fish yield will be greatly reduced. Default is 0ºC.
Maximum map temperature for reduced fish yield
Maximum map temperature for reduced fish yield. Above this temperature fish yield will be greatly reduced. Default is 50ºC.
Fishing Yield multiplier
The amount of fish caught will be scaled by this multiplier.
Fishing Speed multiplier
The speed to catch the fish will be scaled by this multiplier.
Max fish population multiplier
In Odyssey, max fish population in a body of water is defined per biome. This multiplier will be applied to that limit.
Fish amount (in fishing zone) multiplier
Amount of fish that will be present on a fishing zone. This multiplier will be applied to that amount.
Chance for negative outcomes
By default there is a 2% chance that any fishing will result in a negative outcome.

Move "Fish" work type to the lowest priority (requires game reload)

By default, Odyssey puts the Fish work type on the work priority order between Craft and Haul. With this option Fish will be at priority 90, after Research, which was the way this mod worked without Odyssey.
